text: Yes, tree-cover loss occurred on the asset in 2023, but it may not qualify as "deforestation." Data from Hansen/UMD showed a 0.7 ha loss (1.2% of the asset), confirmed by later observations and JRC 2020 reference maps. However, this loss could be due to harvest, fire, or other stand-replacement events rather than deforestation. The area included both planted (0.4 ha) and unmapped forest (0.3 ha), primarily Eucalyptus. Without further details, we cannot determine legality, cause, or responsible parties. The change meets technical evidence standards but does not confirm deforestation under regulatory definitions.
